seoTitle: Physical Therapy Services in Oshkosh, WI
seoDescription: Physical, occupational, hand and aquatic therapy, dry needling, sports medicine, vertigo care and more at Fox Valley Physical Therapy in Oshkosh, WI.
heroText: Everything from rehab after surgery to vertigo to sports injuries, with one-on-one care from start to finish.
ctaText: Call our Oshkosh clinic to schedule. You don't need a referral, and we accept most insurance, including Medicare.
